name: Beam AI
summary: AI takeoff that returns an Excel-ready quantity file from your electrical PDFs, checked by the vendor.
differentiator: Works more like a service than software. You upload plans and get a QA-approved Excel takeoff back in 24 to 72 hours, by the vendor's own account.
pricing: Annual license, priced by trade. Custom quote only.

scope.takeoff: AI extracts quantities for wiring, lighting, grounding, switches, outlets and boxes from PDF plans, then returns an Excel file.
scope.library: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: Estimates are "aligned to your internal formats, pricing logic". No price source is named.

bestFor: Shops with more bids than estimators that want quantities back quickly.
skipIf: You need same-hour turnaround or want to run takeoff yourself.
watchOut: Customer results on the page (such as revenue doubling) are testimonials.
A turnaround of 24 to 72 hours is part of the vendor's description.
